reviews.title: Good monitor, although with some minor details depending on your needs.
reviews.comment:
Excellent monitor. The colors look great with good contrast thanks to the VA panel, and it feels smooth. However, depending on the response time settings, you might experience some ghosting in certain games. Personally, I don't use it for gaming because I have an OLED monitor, so it's not a problem for me.
Something important to keep in mind is that in terms of image quality, if you're coming from, for example, a 24-inch 1080p monitor, you won't notice a significant difference compared to this 32-inch 1440p monitor because they have the same pixel density (PPI: 91.79). So, if you want a true 1440p experience, I recommend going for a 27-inch monitor. Or, if you want a 32-inch monitor, I suggest going for a 4K one if you can afford it. The only advantage of a 32-inch 1440p monitor is that you can sit further away from the screen compared to a 24-inch 1080p monitor. In the image I uploaded, the LG monitor is the one on the right, in case there's any confusion.

reviews.title: Great with some caveats
reviews.comment:
This monitor looks great but man did I have issues with it. I could not get it to work on the correct resolution with the HDMI, it would either start out black or it would turn black when I switched to the correct resolution. The LG support was not able to help me over the phone so they sent me a huge, wrong sized box to mail it to the service center. I didn’t want to deal with that and luckily it works fine with display port. Sometimes I can get the hdmi to work but it’s just really weird and annoying figuring it out.
The other thing I really don’t like about it is that it does automatic brightness adjustment which you can’t disable! It’s meant to help you while you’re gaming and suddenly enter bright or dark areas, but it’s super annoying if you are just doing regular work, especially if you work with graphics/digital art. There’s also a very slight delay before the brightness adjusts so idk how helpful it would even be.
The cables stuck in perpendicular out the back which I guess is good for desktop use, but I have it mounted to the wall so this prevents it from going all the way against the wall. I prefer it when the plugs go out from the bottom and it’s also easier to access.
Other than those issues though it is a great monitor, it looks good, and it’s less expensive that other monitors with the same specs. I can’t really complain since I got a good deal on prime day.
